idea-plugin.name: Folder Tabs
idea-plugin.description:
Groups open editor tabs by their parent directory.

Adds a two-row header above the editor: the upper row lists the directories of the files you have open, the lower row lists the files of the selected directory. Directories with the same name are shown with the shortest path that tells them apart (api/users vs admin/users).

Works with any file type, leaves the standard editor tabs untouched, and uses only stable IntelliJ Platform APIs.
